description: The plot illustrates how “Similarity” varies across model layers for four language pairs (en&en, en&es, en&el, en&bn). The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and shows integer layers from 0 to 23 with ticks at even intervals (0, 2, 4, …, 22). The y-axis is labeled “Similarity,” uses a linear scale from 0.00 to 0.45, and has regularly spaced tick marks every 0.05. Four solid lines without markers are shown: the red en&en line starts near 0.07 at layer 0, rises to about 0.10 by layer 2, increases to a local peak around 0.26 at layer 6, drops to roughly 0.16 at layer 7, stays around 0.15–0.18 through about layers 9–13, declines to about 0.12–0.13 around layers 15–16, falls further to roughly 0.09 by layer 18 and about 0.08 around layers 20–21, then rises sharply to about 0.18 at layer 22 and about 0.43 at layer 23. The blue en&es line begins near 0.06 at layer 0, climbs to about 0.09–0.10 by layers 2–3, reaches a peak near 0.24 at layer 6, drops to about 0.15 at layer 7, remains around 0.15–0.18 through roughly layers 9–13, then decreases to about 0.12 at layer 15, about 0.08 at layer 18, and about 0.06 around layers 20–21, before increasing to about 0.13 at layer 22 and about 0.27 at layer 23. The green en&el line starts around 0.04 at layer 0, rises to about 0.08 at layer 2, dips near 0.06 at layer 3, peaks around 0.15 at layer 6, drops to about 0.10 at layer 7, increases gradually to about 0.14–0.15 around layers 12–13, then declines to about 0.09 at layer 15, about 0.06 at layer 18, and about 0.05 around layers 20–21, followed by an increase to about 0.12 at layer 22 and about 0.30 at layer 23. The pink en&bn line begins near 0.03 at layer 0, rises to about 0.07 at layer 2, dips near 0.05–0.06 at layers 3–4, peaks around 0.14 at layer 6, drops to about 0.09–0.10 at layer 7, climbs to about 0.13–0.14 around layers 12–13, then decreases to about 0.09 at layer 15, about 0.06 at layer 18, and about 0.05–0.06 around layers 20–21, before rising to about 0.14 at layer 22 and about 0.29 at layer 23.
caption_used: The similarity of HSAs in different languages across all layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B is depicted. The line plot shows four language pairs: 'en&en' (red), 'en&es' (blue), 'en&el' (green), and 'en&bn' (pink). The horizontal axis represents the layers, ranging from 0 to 24, while the vertical axis indicates similarity, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45. The red line starts at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, peaks at layer 6 with a value of 0.26, and then declines steadily to 0.08 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.43 at layer 23. The blue line begins at 0.06 at layer 0, peaks at layer 6 with a value of 0.24, and then stabilizes around 0.06 from layer 20 onward, showing no significant increase. The green and pink lines exhibit similar trends, starting at 0.04 and 0.03 respectively, peaking at layer 6 with values of 0.15 and 0.13, and then declining to 0.05 at layer 20 before increasing to 0.3 at layer 23. Notably, the similarity between 'en&es' consistently exceeds that of 'en&en' across layers 6 to 20, contrary to expectations.
